=== DOCS-TRUTH (verified 2026-06-08 via WebFetch trino.io/docs/467/{sql/update,sql/delete,sql/merge,sql/create-table-as,connector/iceberg}.html) ===

• **UPDATE (Trino 467):** `UPDATE table_name SET [(column = expression [, ...])] [WHERE condition]`. Trino 467 Iceberg connector supports row-level UPDATE on format-version 2 tables. Multi-column SET via `SET col1 = expr1, col2 = expr2`. Subquery expressions allowed in SET. Docs example: `UPDATE purchases SET status = 'OVERDUE' WHERE ship_date IS NULL`. Docs note: 'The values of all column update expressions for a matching row are evaluated before any column value is changed' (sets observed-old semantics for self-referential updates).
• **DELETE (Trino 467):** `DELETE FROM table_name [WHERE condition]`. Trino 467 Iceberg connector supports row-level DELETE on format-version 2 tables ('Tables using v2 of the Iceberg specification support deletion of individual rows by writing position delete files'). Docs examples: conditional (`DELETE FROM lineitem WHERE shipmode = 'AIR'`), subquery (`DELETE FROM lineitem WHERE orderkey IN (SELECT orderkey FROM orders WHERE priority = 'LOW')`), and full-table (`DELETE FROM orders` — equivalent to truncating). On Iceberg in MoR mode, the DELETE writes position-delete files; in CoW mode it rewrites data files.
• **MERGE (Trino 467):** `MERGE INTO target_table [[AS] target_alias] USING {source_table | query} [[AS] source_alias] ON search_condition when_clause [...]` with three WHEN clauses: `WHEN MATCHED [AND cond] THEN DELETE`, `WHEN MATCHED [AND cond] THEN UPDATE SET (column = expression [, ...])`, `WHEN NOT MATCHED [AND cond] THEN INSERT [column_list] VALUES (expression, ...)`. WHEN clauses processed IN ORDER (only the first matching WHEN executes). MERGE fails if a single target row matches multiple source rows. Trino 467 does NOT support `WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE` (Spark / SQL-Server / Databricks have it; Trino does not — verified absent from the 467 syntax page). Trino MERGE requires EXPLICIT column lists on both UPDATE SET and INSERT VALUES — no `UPDATE SET *` / `INSERT *` shorthand. MERGE supported on the Iceberg connector by default; on the PostgreSQL connector ONLY from Trino 470+ (NOT 467).
• **CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE AS SELECT (Trino 467):** `CREATE [OR REPLACE] TABLE [IF NOT EXISTS] table_name [(column_alias, ...)] [COMMENT table_comment] [WITH (property_name = expression [, ...])] AS query [WITH [NO] DATA]`. `OR REPLACE and IF NOT EXISTS cannot be used together`. WITH clause supports `partitioning = ARRAY['<transform>', ...]` (each transform a single-quoted STRING; bucket() is COLUMN-FIRST as `bucket(col, N)` on Trino vs Spark's `bucket(N, col)`). On the Iceberg connector verbatim: 'The connector supports replacing an existing table, as an atomic operation. Atomic table replacement creates a new snapshot with the new table definition as part of the table history.' Readers see OLD content until the replace commits, then NEW content — never an empty middle state.
